name: Misasagi Ai
source:
"The Self Proclaimed Big Sister"

A mysterious sister. She spotted the protagonist and started teasing him. She wants to be a good sister but she's quite the impulsive trouble maker who can't read the room.

”My little brother is mine alone, so there!"
